contract: one case file read from memory, one case per line, generated from a seed: random outlines with valid, degenerate, malformed and out-of-range points and contours, each converted, rotated, stroked, transformed and rasterised, the small ones also drawn in runs, with transforms of moderate reach (rotations within 60 degrees, matrices near the target size)

every case performed with libass 0.17.5's own stages, as the pinned build compiles them, with libass's plain C bitmap engine on every host (ass_bitmap_engine_init(ASS_CPU_FLAG_NONE): C functions, 16x16 tiles and 16-byte rows, what a 32-bit ARMv7 build gets from ass_renderer_init): ass_outline_convert, ass_outline_rotate_90, ass_outline_stroke, ass_outline_transform_2d and _3d, ass_outline_to_bitmap; a run through get_bitmap_glyph per glyph (the 3D glyph transform and its quantisation against the run, the stroked border or opaque box, the \kf karaoke leftmost x) and ass_composite_construct (blur, \be, the fill taken out of the border, the shifted shadow); ass_synth_blur, the engine's add, mul and imul blends, ass_fix_outline, ass_shift_bitmap and render_glyph's rectangle clipping with the karaoke split

per case: its status, then every outline's point and segment counts and FNV-1a hash and every bitmap's position, size and the FNV-1a hash of its rows, the run's glyph positions and the clip parts; packets count cases and bytes the outline points and bitmap pixels recorded

a case outside the grammar is recorded as unparsed, and a case the candidate refuses where libass draws is recorded with a status of its own, one for a policy limit (one frame's work, or the crate's size limits), one for the storage budget and one for any other error, so the case fails; the file is read, the glyphs loaded and the cases parsed before each timed and memory operation, and the reference's renderer is created once, outside it
